full_judgment: “1. The property in dispute in the appeal appertains to C.S. plot No. 91 under C.S. Khatian No. 6947 (kha) of Mouza Shahar Dacca, area commonly known as Segun Bagan. A photo copy of the certified copy of the aforesaid C.S. Khatian annexed hereto shows that the land in question was a Nishker held directly under the Bharat Shamrat by Rai Karuna Das Basu Bahadur, Baroda Das Basu to the extent of the one third share each and by Sattaranjan Basu and Gnan Ranjan Basu to the extent of the remaining one third jointly."
